name: Arghadip Chakraborty
intro: I’m Arghadip. I make photographs, follow my curiosity, and collect stories along the way.
about: CuriousDip is my space for looking a little closer — through photo series, personal essays, and notes on the things that catch my eye. I’m interested in the connection between a place, a moment, and the feeling it leaves behind.

aboutSections.title: Hi, I'm Arghadip 👋
paragraphs: This is a place for photographs, personal stories, and the small observations that make an ordinary day worth remembering.
A face in a crowd, a quiet corner, or an unexpected change in the light can be the beginning of a story. Through this space, I hope to give those moments a little room to breathe.

aboutSections.title: Following the curiosity
paragraphs: Some stories begin with a plan. Others begin with a walk, an unfamiliar turning, or a detail that asks for a closer look. This journal makes space for both.
These are draft words for an introduction that will grow over time — a little about the places, people, and experiences behind the photographs, and the questions that keep me looking.

aboutSections.title: More than a single frame
paragraphs: A photograph can stand on its own, but a sequence of images can open a longer conversation. CuriousDip brings those frames together with words, allowing each story to find its own pace.
There is more to add here: the personal background, the journeys, and the moments that shaped this work. For now, these pages are an invitation to explore and stay curious.
